commits.messageBody:
agentdeck repo set <repo> tools "<rules>" replaces a repo's tool rules, and
"" goes back to the defaults plus the rules detected from its toolchain. The
same setting through POST /api/repos/:id (allowed_tools) and the repo editor.
repo ls and the repo page say which rules are in use (tools_source).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <person@example.com>
commits.messageHeadline: Tool rules can be changed: repo set <repo> tools
